right.why_checkable: The client-facing leg can be exercised with TLS server conformance tests.

evidence.quote:
A middlebox which terminates a TLS connection MUST behave as a
       compliant TLS server (to the original client), including having a
       certificate which the client is willing to accept, and also as a
       compliant TLS client (to the original server), including verifying
       the original server's certificate.

right.condition: exporter_master_secret or early_exporter_master_secret is derived
right.required_behavior: domain-separate the exporter master secrets from the traffic keys
right.forbidden_behavior: derive an exporter master secret so that it exposes or aliases a traffic key

derived to be independent of the traffic keys and therefore do not
represent a threat to the security of traffic encrypted with those

Because the
      ClientHello, EndOfEarlyData, ServerHello, Finished, and KeyUpdate
      messages can immediately precede a key change, implementations
      MUST send these messages in alignment with a record boundary.
